SELECT
	Id id,
	NameId name_id,
	ReflectionType reflection_type,
	DescriptionId description_id,
	SupportMode support_mode
FROM VoucherNumberAlgorithm

SELECT DISTINCT
	VNR.Id id,
	VNR.VoucherNumberPrefix voucher_number_prefix,
	VNR.VoucherNumberType voucher_number_type,
	VNR.VoucherNumberLength voucher_number_length,
	VNR.VoucherNumberExample voucher_number_example,
	CASE 
		WHEN P.PinCodeType = 0 THEN 0
		WHEN P.PinCodeType = 1 AND P.PinCodeLength = 4 THEN 1
		WHEN P.PinCodeType = 1 AND P.PinCodeLength = 6 THEN 2
		WHEN P.PinCodeType = 1 AND P.PinCodeLength = 8 THEN 3
		WHEN P.PinCodeType = 2 AND P.PinCodeLength = 4 THEN 4
		WHEN P.PinCodeType = 2 AND P.PinCodeLength = 6 THEN 5
		ELSE NULL END pin_type,
	ISNULL(PBS.IsShowcodeTypeDisplayText, ISNULL(VNR.DisplayText, 0)) dist_voucher_num_under_barcode,
	CASE 
		WHEN PBS.ShowcodeType IS NOT NULL THEN CASE PBS.ShowcodeType
			WHEN 'Code39' THEN 1 
			WHEN 'Code128A' THEN 2  
			WHEN 'Code128B' THEN 3
			WHEN 'Code128C' THEN 4
			WHEN 'EAN-13' THEN 5
			WHEN 'QrCode' THEN 6
			WHEN 'Text' THEN 7 
			ELSE 1 END
		WHEN VNR.ShowCodeType IS NOT NULL THEN CASE VNR.ShowCodeType 
			WHEN 'Code39' THEN 1 
			WHEN 'Code128A' THEN 2  
			WHEN 'Code128B' THEN 3
			WHEN 'Code128C' THEN 4
			WHEN 'EAN-13' THEN 5
			WHEN 'QrCode' THEN 6
			WHEN 'Text' THEN 7 
			ELSE 1 END
		ELSE 1 END barcode_type_id,
	VNR.VoucherNumberAlgorithmId algorithm_id,
	ISNULL(VNR.Operater, 'TX2') created_by,
	GETUTCDATE() created_datetime,
	mm.TXCMerchantId merchant_id,
	ISNULL(VNR.RuleName, 'VNR_' + CAST(VNR.Id AS varchar)) rule_name,
	VNR.VoucherGenerator voucher_number_generator,
	NULL voucher_generate_way,
	VNR.RequireExpiryDate request_expiry_date,
	VNR.HasMultiBarcode has_multipart_barcode
FROM VoucherNumberRule VNR
LEFT JOIN Product P ON VNR.Id = P.VoucherNumberRuleId
LEFT OUTER JOIN ProductBarcodeSetting PBS ON P.Id = PBS.Id
LEFT OUTER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON VNR.MerchantId = MM.TX2MerchantId
WHERE VNR.MerchantId IS NOT NULL OR P.Id IS NOT NULL

SELECT
	P.Id sku_id,
	VNR.Id voucher_number_rule_id
FROM Product P
INNER JOIN VoucherNumberRule VNR ON P.VoucherNumberRuleId = VNR.Id
LEFT OUTER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId AND PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1
WHERE PV.Id IS NOT NULL

BEGIN
	INSERT INTO BrandTest (BrandName, MediaId, Status, CreateTime, Creater)
	VALUES (@BrandName, @MediaId, @Status, @CreateTime, @Creater)

	SET @TX2BrandId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	INSERT INTO TXCBrandMapping (BrandId, TXCTenantId, ExternalId)

		MediaId = @MediaId,
		Status = @Status,
		CreateTime = @CreateTime,
		Creater = @Creater

update sync
set sync.TX2MerchantId = m.TX2MerchantId 
from [dbo].[TXCCreateContractSync] sync 
inner join TXCMerchantMapping m on sync.TXCMerchantId = m.TXCMerchantId
where m.TenantId = @TenantId AND sync.RunId = @RunId

update sync
set sync.TX2ProductId = p.ProductId 
from [dbo].[TXCCreateContractSync] sync 
inner join TXCProductMapping p on sync.TXCProductId = p.ExternalId
where p.TXCTenantId = @TenantId AND sync.RunId = @RunId

update sync
set sync.TX2ProductVersionId = pv.Id
from [dbo].[TXCCreateContractSync] sync
inner join ProductVersion pv on sync.TX2ProductId = pv.ProductId
where pv.IsCurrentVersion = 1 AND sync.RunId = @RunId

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCCreateContractSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2MerchantId IS NULL)
	THROW 99999, 'Merchant Mapping Error', 1
ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCCreateContractSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2ProductId IS NULL)
	THROW 99999, 'Product Mapping Error', 1

Declare @SessionId varchar(50);
Declare @RedemptionId int
Declare @ReverseRedemptionId int
Declare @PreAuthCompleteId int
Declare @ReversePreAuthCompleteId int

Declare @InsertedContract table(
	MerchantContractId int,
	ProductVersionId int,
	TXCContractSkuCostId int,
	Cost decimal(18,2),
	MerchantId int,
	StartDate datetime,
	EndDate datetime  
);


select @RedemptionId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 101
select @ReverseRedemptionId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 201
select @PreAuthCompleteId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 103
select @ReversePreAuthCompleteId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 203


while exists (select * from TXCCreateContractSync with(nolock) where RunId = @RunId AND SessionId is null)
begin
	set @SessionId = newid();
	update top(100) TXCCreateContractSync
	set SessionId = @SessionId
	where RunId = @RunId AND SessionId is null

	delete sync from TXCCreateContractSync sync 
	inner join MerchantContract mc on sync.TX2MerchantId = mc.MerchantId AND sync.TX2ProductVersionId = mc.ProductVersionId AND sync.StartDate = mc.ValidFrom AND sync.EndDate = mc.ValidTo
	where sync.RunId = @RunId AND sync.SessionId = @SessionId

	insert into MerchantContract(MerchantId, ProductVersionId, ValidFrom, ValidTo, IsUseDefaultCost, CreatedBy, CreatedOn)
	output inserted.Id as MerchantContractId, inserted.ProductVersionId, 0 as TXCContractSkuCostId, 0 as Cost, inserted.MerchantId, inserted.ValidFrom as StartDate, inserted.ValidTo as EndDate
	into @InsertedContract
	select TX2MerchantId as MerchantId,
	TX2ProductVersionId as ProductVersionId,
	StartDate as ValidFrom,
	EndDate as ValidTo,
	0 as IsUseDefaultCost,
	CreatedBy,
	CreatedOn
	from TXCCreateContractSync with(nolock) where RunId = @RunId AND SessionId = @SessionId

	update ic
	set ic.TXCContractSkuCostId = sync.TXCContractSkuCostId, ic.Cost = sync.Cost 
	from @InsertedContract ic
	inner join TXCCreateContractSync sync on ic.ProductVersionId = sync.TX2ProductVersionId
	AND ic.MerchantId = sync.TX2MerchantId AND ic.StartDate = sync.StartDate AND ic.EndDate = sync.EndDate


	--insert into TempMerchantContract(MerchantContractId, ProductVersionId, TXCContractSkuCostId, Cost, MerchantId, StartDate, EndDate)
	--select MerchantContractId, ProductVersionId, TXCContractSkuCostId, Cost, MerchantId, StartDate, EndDate from @InsertedContract

	insert into TXCMerchantContractMapping(MerchantContractId, TXCContractSkuCostId, TenantId)
	select MerchantContractId, TXCContractSkuCostId as TXCContractSkuCostId, @TenantId as TenantId from @InsertedContract

	insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
	select MerchantContractId, @RedemptionId as TransactionTypeId, Cost as [Value] from @InsertedContract

	insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
	select MerchantContractId, @ReverseRedemptionId as TransactionTypeId, (-1*Cost) as [Value] from @InsertedContract

	insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
	select MerchantContractId, @PreAuthCompleteId as TransactionTypeId, Cost as [Value] from @InsertedContract

	insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
	select MerchantContractId, @ReversePreAuthCompleteId as TransactionTypeId, (-1*Cost) as [Value] from @InsertedContract
	
	delete from @InsertedContract

end
--delete from TXCCreateContractSync where RunId = @RunId

SELECT 
	id Id,
	voucher_number_prefix VoucherNumberPrefix,

		WHEN 1 THEN 'Code39'
		WHEN 2 THEN 'Code128A'
		WHEN 3 THEN 'Code128B'
		WHEN 4 THEN 'Code128C'
		WHEN 5 THEN 'EAN-13'
		WHEN 6 THEN 'QrCode'
		WHEN 7 THEN 'Text'
		ELSE NULL END ShowCodeType,
	dist_voucher_num_under_barcode DisplayText,
	request_expiry_date RequireExpiryDate,

	merchant_id TXCMerchantId
FROM merchant_info.tb_vnr_voucher_number_rule

UPDATE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync SET TX2MerchantId = m.TX2MerchantId
FROM TXCMerchantMapping m
WHERE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync.TXCMerchantId = m.TXCMerchantId
AND TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync.RunId = @RunId

--UPDATE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync SET TX2AlgorithmId = a.TX2VoucherNumberAlgorithmId
--FROM TXCVoucherNumberAlgorithmMapping a
--WHERE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync.TXCAlgorithmId = a.TXCVoucherNumberAlgorithmId
--AND TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync.RunId = @RunId

UPDATE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync SET TX2AlgorithmId = TXCAlgorithmId
WHERE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync.RunId = @RunId

BEGIN
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

	BEGIN TRANSACTION; 

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync WHERE RunId = @RunId)
			BEGIN
			    SET IDENTITY_INSERT [dbo].[VoucherNumberRule] ON;  
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[VoucherNumberRule]
						   ([Id]
						   ,[VoucherNumberPrefix]
						   ,[VoucherNumberType]
						   ,[VoucherNumberLength]
						   ,[VoucherNumberExample]
						   ,[VoucherNumberAlgorithmId]
						   ,[VoucherGenerator]
						   ,[MerchantId]
						   ,[RuleName]
						   ,[PinCodeType]
						   ,[HasMultiBarcode]
						   ,[ShowCodeType]
						   ,[DisplayText]
						   ,[RequireExpiryDate])
				SELECT  
					Id,
					VoucherNumberPrefix,
					VoucherNumberType,
				    VoucherNumberLength,
					VoucherNumberExample,
					TX2AlgorithmId,
					VoucherGenerator,
					TX2MerchantId,
					RuleName,
					PinCodeType,
					HasMultiBarcode,
					ShowCodeType,
					DisplayText,
					RequireExpiryDate
				FROM TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync WHERE RunId = @RunId
		        SET IDENTITY_INSERT [dbo].[VoucherNumberRule] OFF;
			END
	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
				 			 
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH 
       IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
       BEGIN
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
       END;

		THROW
    END CATCH;
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF;
END

BEGIN TRY

	BEGIN TRANSACTION; 

	MERGE INTO dbo.ProductBannerImageSetting AS t
	USING (select * from TXCProductBannerImageSettingSync WHERE RunId = @RunId) AS S
	ON t.ProductId = s.TX2ProductId
	WHEN MATCHED
	THEN UPDATE SET t.HexColor = s.hex_color,t.FontSize = s.font_size, t.PointX
	= s.point_x, t.PointY = s.point_y
	WHEN NOT MATCHED
	THEN INSERT (ProductId,HexColor,FontSize,PointX,PointY)  VALUES(s.TX2ProductId,s.hex_color,s.font_size,s.point_x,s.point_y);

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
				 			 
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH 
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
    END;

  THROW 99999, 'Fail to sync product banner image setting', 1
END CATCH;

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCProductBannerImageSettingSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2ProductId IS NULL)

AND TXCAcceptanceLoopSync.RunId = @RunId

FROM TXCShopMapping s
WHERE TXCAcceptanceLoopSync.TXCShopId = s.TXCShopId
AND TXCAcceptanceLoopSync.RunId = @RunId

DECLARE @ProductId int
DECLARE @AcceptanceLoopId int
DECLARE @MerchantId int
DECLARE @AcceptanceLoopMerchantId int

BEGIN TRAN
BEGIN TRY

	DECLARE C CURSOR FOR
	SELECT DISTINCT TX2ProductId FROM TXCAcceptanceLoopSync WHERE RunId = @RunId

	OPEN C;
	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @ProductId

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoop DEFAULT VALUES
		SET @AcceptanceLoopId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		DECLARE inner_cursor CURSOR FOR
		SELECT DISTINCT TX2MerchantId FROM TXCAcceptanceLoopSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2ProductId = @ProductId

		OPEN inner_cursor;
		FETCH NEXT FROM inner_cursor INTO @MerchantId

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMerchant (AcceptanceLoopId, MerchantId)
			VALUES (@AcceptanceLoopId, @MerchantId)
			SET @AcceptanceLoopMerchantId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopShop (AcceptanceLoopMerchantId, ShopId)
			SELECT @AcceptanceLoopMerchantId, TX2ShopId
			FROM TXCAcceptanceLoopSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2ProductId = @ProductId AND TX2MerchantId = @MerchantId AND TXCShopId IS NOT NULL
			
			FETCH NEXT FROM inner_cursor INTO @MerchantId
		END

		CLOSE inner_cursor
		DEALLOCATE inner_cursor


		UPDATE Product SET AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId WHERE Id = @ProductId
		UPDATE ProductVersion SET AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId WHERE ProductId = @ProductId AND IsCurrentVersion = 1
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @ProductId
	END

	CLOSE C
	DEALLOCATE C

	COMMIT TRAN;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
	ROLLBACK TRAN;
	THROW;
END CATCH

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCAcceptanceLoopSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2ProductId IS NULL)
	THROW 99999, 'Product Mapping Error', 1
ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCAcceptanceLoopSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2MerchantId IS NULL)
	THROW 99999, 'Merchant Mapping Error', 1
ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCAcceptanceLoopSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2ShopId IS NULL)
	THROW 99999, 'Shop Mapping Error', 1

Declare @SessionId varchar(50);
Declare @StartDate DateTime;
Declare @EndDate DateTime;
Declare @RedemptionId int
Declare @ReverseRedemptionId int
Declare @PreAuthCompleteId int
Declare @ReversePreAuthCompleteId int

select @RedemptionId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 101
select @ReverseRedemptionId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 201
select @PreAuthCompleteId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 103
select @ReversePreAuthCompleteId = Id from Dictionary with(nolock) 
where Category = 'TransactionType' AND [Name] = 203

Declare @InsertedContract table(
	MerchantContractId int,
	ProductVersionId int,
	TXCContractSkuCostId int,
	Cost decimal(18,2),
	MerchantId int,
	StartDate datetime,
	EndDate datetime 
);

Declare @TXCUpdateFutureContract table(
	TXCUpdateContractId int
);

Declare @TXCUpdateActiveContract table(
	TXCUpdateContractId int
);

while exists (select * from TXCUpdateContractSync with(nolock) where RunId = @RunId AND SessionId is null)
begin

	set @SessionId = newid();
	update top(100) TXCUpdateContractSync
	set SessionId = @SessionId
	where RunId = @RunId AND SessionId is null

	insert into @TXCUpdateFutureContract(TXCUpdateContractId)
	select map.TXCContractSkuCostId
	from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
	inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
	inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
	where map.TenantId = @TenantId AND sync.RunId = @RunId AND sync.SessionId = @SessionId AND mc.ValidFrom > getutcdate()

	insert into @TXCUpdateActiveContract(TXCUpdateContractId)
	select map.TXCContractSkuCostId
	from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
	inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
	inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
	where map.TenantId = @TenantId AND sync.RunId = @RunId AND sync.SessionId = @SessionId AND mc.ValidFrom <= getutcdate()	

	if exists (select 1 from @TXCUpdateFutureContract)
	begin
	--insert into ADFLog(Val) values ('0')
		update mc 
		set mc.ValidFrom = sync.StartDate, mc.ValidTo = sync.EndDate  
		from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
		inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join @TXCUpdateFutureContract fu on fu.TXCUpdateContractId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		
		update rs
		set rs.[Value] = sync.Cost
		from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
		inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		inner join ReimbursementScheme rs with(nolock) on rs.MerchantContractId = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join @TXCUpdateFutureContract fu on fu.TXCUpdateContractId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		where rs.TransactionTypeId = @RedemptionId
		
		update rs
		set rs.[Value] = (-1*sync.Cost)		
		from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
		inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		inner join ReimbursementScheme rs with(nolock) on rs.MerchantContractId = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join @TXCUpdateFutureContract fu on fu.TXCUpdateContractId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		where rs.TransactionTypeId = @ReverseRedemptionId

		update rs
		set rs.[Value] = sync.Cost
		from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
		inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		inner join ReimbursementScheme rs with(nolock) on rs.MerchantContractId = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join @TXCUpdateFutureContract fu on fu.TXCUpdateContractId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		where rs.TransactionTypeId = @PreAuthCompleteId

		update rs
		set rs.[Value] = (-1*sync.Cost)
		from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
		inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		inner join ReimbursementScheme rs with(nolock) on rs.MerchantContractId = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join @TXCUpdateFutureContract fu on fu.TXCUpdateContractId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		where rs.TransactionTypeId = @ReversePreAuthCompleteId
		
	end

	if exists(
		select 1 from @TXCUpdateActiveContract	
	)
	begin
	--insert into ADFLog(Val) values ('1')
		update mc 
		set mc.ValidTo = getdate()  
		from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
		inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join @TXCUpdateActiveContract ac on ac.TXCUpdateContractId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId	
					
		insert into MerchantContract(MerchantId, ProductVersionId, ValidFrom, ValidTo, IsUseDefaultCost, CreatedBy, CreatedOn)
		output inserted.Id as MerchantContractId, inserted.ProductVersionId, 0 as TXCContractSkuCostId, 0 as Cost, inserted.MerchantId, inserted.ValidFrom as StartDate, inserted.ValidTo as EndDate
		into @InsertedContract
		select sync.TX2MerchantId as MerchantId,
		sync.TX2ProductVersionId as ProductVersionId,
		sync.StartDate as ValidFrom,
		sync.EndDate as ValidTo,
		0 as IsUseDefaultCost,
		IsNull(sync.UpdatedBy, 'TXC') as CreatedBy,
		getdate() as CreatedOn
		from TXCUpdateContractSync sync with(nolock)
		inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map with(nolock) on sync.TXCContractSkuCostId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId
		inner join MerchantContract mc with(nolock) on mc.Id = map.MerchantContractId
		inner join @TXCUpdateActiveContract ac on ac.TXCUpdateContractId = map.TXCContractSkuCostId				
		
		update ic
		set ic.TXCContractSkuCostId = sync.TXCContractSkuCostId, ic.Cost = sync.Cost 
		from @InsertedContract ic
		inner join TXCUpdateContractSync sync on ic.ProductVersionId = sync.TX2ProductVersionId	
		AND ic.MerchantId = sync.TX2MerchantId AND ic.StartDate = sync.StartDate AND ic.EndDate = sync.EndDate	
		
		--CREATE TABLE dbo.TempMerchantContract
		--(
		--	Id INT IDENTITY(1,1) CONSTRAINT PK_TempMerchantContract_Id PRIMARY KEY,
		--	MerchantContractId int null,
		--	ProductVersionId int null,
		--	TXCContractSkuCostId int null,
		--	Cost decimal(18,2),
		--	MerchantId int,
		--	StartDate datetime,
		--	EndDate datetime 
		--)

		--insert into TempMerchantContract(MerchantContractId, ProductVersionId, TXCContractSkuCostId, Cost, MerchantId, StartDate, EndDate)
		--select MerchantContractId, ProductVersionId, TXCContractSkuCostId, Cost, MerchantId, StartDate, EndDate from @InsertedContract

		update map
		set map.MerchantContractId = ic.MerchantContractId 
		from @InsertedContract ic inner join TXCMerchantContractMapping map on map.TXCContractSkuCostId = ic.TXCContractSkuCostId
		AND map.TenantId = @TenantId

		insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
		select MerchantContractId, @RedemptionId as TransactionTypeId, Cost as [Value] from @InsertedContract

		insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
		select MerchantContractId, @ReverseRedemptionId as TransactionTypeId, (-1*Cost) as [Value] from @InsertedContract

		insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
		select MerchantContractId, @PreAuthCompleteId as TransactionTypeId, Cost as [Value] from @InsertedContract

		insert into ReimbursementScheme(MerchantContractId, TransactionTypeId, [Value])
		select MerchantContractId, @ReversePreAuthCompleteId as TransactionTypeId, (-1*Cost) as [Value] from @InsertedContract		
		
	end

	delete from @InsertedContract		
	delete from @TXCUpdateFutureContract
	delete from @TXCUpdateActiveContract
end

update sync
set sync.TX2MerchantId = m.TX2MerchantId 
from [dbo].[TXCUpdateContractSync] sync 
inner join TXCMerchantMapping m on sync.TXCMerchantId = m.TXCMerchantId
where m.TenantId = @TenantId AND sync.RunId = @RunId

update sync
set sync.TX2ProductId = p.ProductId 
from [dbo].[TXCUpdateContractSync] sync 
inner join TXCProductMapping p on sync.TXCProductId = p.ExternalId
where p.TXCTenantId = @TenantId AND sync.RunId = @RunId

update sync
set sync.TX2ProductVersionId = pv.Id
from [dbo].[TXCUpdateContractSync] sync
inner join ProductVersion pv on sync.TX2ProductId = pv.ProductId
where pv.IsCurrentVersion = 1 AND sync.RunId = @RunId

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCUpdateContractSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2MerchantId IS NULL)
	THROW 99999, 'Merchant Mapping Error', 1
ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TXCUpdateContractSync WHERE RunId = @RunId AND TX2ProductId IS NULL)
	THROW 99999, 'Product Mapping Error', 1
--delete from TXCUpdateContractSync where RunId = @RunId

UPDATE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync SET TX2AlgorithmId = TXCAlgorithmId
WHERE TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync.RunId = @RunId

BEGIN
	SET XACT_ABORT ON;
	
	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION; 
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync WHERE RunId = @RunId)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[VoucherNumberRule] SET
				[VoucherNumberPrefix] = sync.VoucherNumberPrefix
				,[VoucherNumberType] = sync.VoucherNumberType
				,[VoucherNumberLength] = sync.VoucherNumberLength
				,[VoucherNumberExample] = sync.VoucherNumberExample
				,[VoucherNumberAlgorithmId]= sync.TX2AlgorithmId
				,[VoucherGenerator] = sync.VoucherGenerator
				,[MerchantId] = sync.TXCMerchantId
				,[RuleName]= sync.RuleName
				,[PinCodeType]= sync.PinCodeType
				,[HasMultiBarcode]= sync.HasMultiBarcode
				,[ShowCodeType] = sync.ShowCodeType
				,[DisplayText]= sync.DisplayText
				,[RequireExpiryDate]= sync.RequireExpiryDate
			FROM [dbo].[TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync] sync
			WHERE [dbo].[VoucherNumberRule].Id = sync.Id AND sync.RunId = @RunId
		END
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH 
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		END;
		THROW
	END CATCH;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;
END

DECLARE @VoucherNumberRuleId INT
DECLARE @TXCPinCodeType INT
DECLARE @PinCodeType TINYINT
DECLARE @PinCodeLength TINYINT

DECLARE C CURSOR FOR
SELECT Id, PinCodeType FROM TXCVoucherNumberRuleSync WHERE RunId = @RunId

OPEN C;
FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @VoucherNumberRuleId, @TXCPinCodeType
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SET @PinCodeType = CASE @TXCPinCodeType WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN 1 WHEN 4 THEN 2 WHEN 5 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
	SET @PinCodeLength = CASE @TXCPinCodeType WHEN 1 THEN 4 WHEN 2 THEN 6 WHEN 3 THEN 8 WHEN 4 THEN 4 WHEN 5 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END

	UPDATE Product SET PinCodeType = @PinCodeType, PinCodeLength = @PinCodeLength
	WHERE VoucherNumberRuleId = @VoucherNumberRuleId

	UPDATE ProductVersion SET PinCodeType = @PinCodeType, PinCodeLength = @PinCodeLength
	FROM Product P
	WHERE ProductVersion.ProductId = P.Id
	AND ProductVersion.IsCurrentVersion = 1
	AND P.VoucherNumberRuleId = @VoucherNumberRuleId

	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @VoucherNumberRuleId, @TXCPinCodeType
END

CLOSE C
DEALLOCATE C
